sentences.text: No: for a Tier 4 UCB, prepayment charges are not permitted on business-purpose loans to Micro and Small Enterprises sanctioned on or after 2026-01-01.
Your loan is a new MSME term loan sanctioned on 2026-03-15, so these directions apply.
The bank’s own policy says 2% foreclosure charges plus GST are levied on all term loans pre-closed by the borrower, but the RBI direction for this case says no prepayment charges may be levied.
Because the charge is not permitted for this case, the 2% pre-payment charge in the sanction letter does not comply with the RBI directions.
